administration.note: Reform UK won the 1 May 2025 all-out election (41 of 68, including Higham Ferrers on 12 June 2025) and runs the Executive with a majority. Leader Cllr Martin Griffiths survived an internal leadership challenge 28-12 on 14 April 2026 and was re-confirmed at the 21 May 2026 AGM. Composition: Reform 41, Conservative 11, Green 8, Labour 4, Independent 3, Liberal Democrat 1. Leader of the Opposition: Cllr Helen Harrison (Conservative, 11).

mtfs.intervention_status: No current S114/EFS-2026/BVN on its own account, BUT a troubled legacy: inherited Northamptonshire CC intervention (capitalisation direction, GBP 3.9m EFS), a DISCLAIMED audit opinion, and three significant weaknesses. DSG deficit forecast over GBP 69m by end 2026/27.
